_comment: Adjoint backward linear solver: transposed CPR (cprt) with hypre BoomerAMG as the pressure/coarse solve. Use via --adjoint-linear-solver=<this file>. cprt applies the CPR two-stage preconditioner to the TRANSPOSED reservoir system (the adjoint canonical form); the coarse (pressure) level is solved by hypre AMG, which scales to field size where umfpack's direct factors blow up in memory (SPE9: umfpack backward 4 GB vs iterative ~0.35 GB). REQUIRES an opm-simulators built with HAVE_HYPRE (this tree has USE_HYPRE=ON in the cache but HAVE_HYPRE was not compiled into config.h, so the hypre preconditioner is not registered yet -- rebuild opm-simulators with hypre to use this). Falls back to the amg coarse solver by changing coarsesolver.preconditioner.type to amg.
